We're not done with point clouds

Clayton Ramsey - 2026-08-10

If you wait long enough to solve a problem, someone else might just solve it for you. At least that is what I tell myself about the dishes in my sink.

While in Vienna for a conference, I found another set of researchers who extended work I had published two years ago and beat me on almost every benchmark.

If you do not care about details, you can jump straight to the paper or to the original implementation and compare the results directly.

Recapt

Motion planning searches for collision-free movements from a start state to a goal state, and efficient point-cloud checks are important to that process.
